generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
General conditions/ Terms and conditions are applied as per uploaded document in e portal

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

STD 3.2 - To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2022-23 to 2026-27)(b) Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for similar works such as Artistic works and Formation of Animal/Birds Mount ie, Rs. 11.445 Lakhs

STD 3.3 - Each Tenderer should further demonstrate (b) Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than 30% of the amount of contract ie., 6.86 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.)
